visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit indoor living room with light wood floors. Two young girls are the focus; one wears a white t-shirt and blue shorts, sitting and touching a blue hexagonal game frame, while the other in a white polka-dot dress stands nearby. The background is filled with children's toys on wooden shelves and a large window showing green trees. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the girl in the polka-dot dress who is crying with her mouth open and eyes squinted, pointing at the toy. Her expression is distressed as she gestures toward the floor. (3) An adult woman in a white shirt joins the children on the floor, crouching down. She uses her hands to demonstrate assembling small blue and white hexagonal blocks into the plastic frame while the girls observe. (4) Multiple hands are seen in a medium close-up as the mother and children work together to fill the frame with translucent plastic ice-blocks. A smartphone rests on the floor nearby among scattered toy pieces. (5) Once the frame is full, the girls each take a grey toy hammer. They strike the surface of the blocks rhythmically. The scene is shot from an eye-level perspective focusing on the interaction between the kids and the toy. (6) The blocks collapse and fall out of the frame entirely. The girls react with surprise and happiness, looking at the scattered pieces on the floor. (7) The video concludes with a pink end card featuring a cartoon girl illustration and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
